title: Lotti+smartphone 01 (1) ies.webm
author: Frank Vincentz
adaptations: Official Wikimedia 480p VP9 transcode. Integration extracts reference frames at 20 and 35 seconds and re-encodes held-out video 40..55 seconds with no compositing, pasted crops or invented frames. The first single-20-second-view attempt failed and remains separately recorded. Preserve this attribution with derived frames/video.
visual_review: Frames at 1,10,20,30,60,70 seconds inspected locally. A physical HTC One phone rests on patterned carpet; a cat approaches and occludes it, and phone angle changes in later frames. Not a human pickup/release trial, not large cross-zone movement, not the user's phone.
